overview: The subcommittee established a timeline for the district's strategic planning process, targeting a final plan by February 2027. Members agreed to summarize existing community survey data by June 2026 and discussed integrating the plan with ongoing middle school facility and grade configuration studies.

items.title: Meeting Opening and Resolution Review
items.summary: The meeting was called to order and the subcommittee reviewed its charge to establish deliverables and timelines for a community-informed strategic plan.

items.title: Strategic Plan Development and Timeline
items.summary: The subcommittee set a goal to finalize a draft strategic plan by February 2027, with an initial summary of community survey results to be completed by the end of the current school year. Discussion focused on utilizing existing data from instructional visions and the high school educational plan to avoid community 'interview fatigue.'

items.title: Alignment with Middle School Task Force
items.summary: Members discussed coordinating the strategic planning process with the task force addressing elementary overcrowding and potential middle school grade reconfigurations. The committee determined that the strategic plan should proceed concurrently to provide high-level guiding principles for these facility decisions.

items.title: Consultant Procurement and Next Steps
items.summary: The administration reported seeking a Bar Foundation grant to hire a technical consultant, such as Lynch Leadership, to lead the drafting process. A progress update and review of survey findings was scheduled for the June 15th School Committee meeting.

subject: District Strategic Planning Process and Timeline
